module_summary: RISC-V CSR execution unit: decodes CSR/system opcodes, reads a CSR register file child, computes set/clear write data and exceptions into E1 pipeline registers, and registers trap branches, interrupts and MMU flushes.

anchors.name: opcode_valid_i
anchors.why: Issue valid qualifying all opcode decodes and E1 register updates.

anchors.name: opcode_opcode_i
anchors.why: Instruction word decoded into CSR ops and CSR read address.

anchors.name: rd_result_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 CSR read result or faulting opcode driven to csr_result_e1_value_o.

anchors.name: exception_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 exception code: ecall, eret, breakpoint, illegal, fence flush.

anchors.name: branch_q
anchors.why: Registered CSR branch request for reset vector or trap entry/return.

anchors.name: csr_wdata_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 CSR write value from set/clear of read data and operand.

anchors.name: rd_valid_e1_q
anchors.why: E1 CSR write enable when CSR op has no access fault.

anchors.name: csr_rdata_w
anchors.why: CSR file read data feeding E1 result and set/clear computation.

anchors.name: set_r
anchors.why: Decoded CSR set-type op steering write data and E1 valid.

anchors.name: csr_fault_r
anchors.why: CSR access fault for read-only write or privilege violation; forces illegal exception.

anchors.name: branch_target_q
anchors.why: Registered branch target: reset vector or CSR trap target.

anchors.name: take_interrupt_q
anchors.why: Registered interrupt launch request from masked pending interrupts.

anchors.name: status_reg_w
anchors.why: Status CSR from file driving MMU privilege, SUM and MXR outputs.

anchors.name: csr_writeback_write_i
anchors.why: Writeback CSR write enable gating CSR file write address.

anchors.name: clr_r
anchors.why: Decoded CSR clear-type op steering write data.

anchors.name: data_r
anchors.why: Operand mux selecting immediate index or register operand for CSR write.

anchors.name: csrrw_w
anchors.why: Decoded CSRRW instruction feeding set/clear and write decode.

anchors.name: csrrwi_w
anchors.why: Decoded CSRRWI immediate form selecting immediate operand.

anchors.name: eret_w
anchors.why: Decoded xRET instruction checked for privilege fault.

anchors.name: eret_fault_w
anchors.why: xRET above current privilege; forces illegal-instruction exception.

anchors.name: satp_update_w
anchors.why: SATP write detect triggering fence exception and TLB flush.

anchors.name: sfence_w
anchors.why: Decoded SFENCE causing TLB flush and fence exception.

anchors.name: ifence_w
anchors.why: Decoded FENCE.I driving ifence pulse and fence exception.

anchors.name: tlb_flush_q
anchors.why: Registered MMU TLB flush request driving mmu_flush_o.

anchors.name: ifence_q
anchors.why: Registered instruction fence request driving ifence_o.

anchors.name: current_priv_w
anchors.why: Current privilege level from CSR file used in fault checks and MMU.

anchors.name: satp_reg_w
anchors.why: SATP CSR value driving mmu_satp_o and branch privilege.

anchors.name: interrupt_w
anchors.why: Masked pending interrupts from CSR file feeding take_interrupt_q.

anchors.name: csr_writeback_wdata_i
anchors.why: Writeback CSR write data to the CSR file.

anchors.name: csr_writeback_exception_i
anchors.why: Writeback exception code driving CSR trap updates.

groups.name: csr_opcode_decoder
groups.description: Decodes CSR/system opcodes, operand select and access-fault detection.

groups.name: csr_register_file
groups.description: Child CSR file: read mux, writeback updates, trap branch and interrupt masking.

groups.name: e1_result_stage
groups.description: E1 registers holding CSR read result, write data, write valid and exception.

groups.name: branch_control
groups.description: Registers reset-vector or CSR trap branch request and target.

groups.name: interrupt_mmu_control
groups.description: Registered interrupt take, TLB flush, ifence and MMU control outputs.
